_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Materials and Processes Substantiating Data and Analysis Test Plan
summary: Identifies the approach for documenting test plans and procedures that substantiate the materials and processes used to develop materiel, ensuring system performance requirements are met.
use_relationship:
The Materials and Processes Substantiating Data and Analysis Test Plan identifies the approach for documenting test plans and procedures that will substantiate the materials and processes used to develop materiel. The plan will be used to assess the materiel development approach to ensure system performance requirements are met.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described by the contract SOW.

This DID interfaces with DI-SESS-82237A, Materials and Processes Substantiating Data and Analysis Test Report.

This DID supersedes DI-SESS-82236.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Materials and Processes Substantiating Data and Analysis Test Plan shall contain the following:

children.title: Materials and Processes Evaluation
children.content: Describe the plan used to evaluate all proposed materials and processes to be used on the system for their ability to meet system performance requirements.

children.title: Testing Methods for Material Properties
Describe plans for all research and
children.content: development, testing, and fabrication studies to be accomplished with respect to materials and processes development.

children.title: Describe plans to conduct materials testing
Describe the tasks to be performed for the
children.content: evaluation and substantiation of material properties.

children.title: Describe plans for developing non-destructive test
children.content: accept/reject criteria, materials processing effects and parameters, material fabrication techniques, and manufacturing procedures.

children.title: Describe program specific test objectives
children.content: test methods, test procedures, test conditions, and test matrices.

children.title: Describe plans to validate the methods to
children.content: be used in the testing and evaluation of materials.

children.title: Describe the plan for materials testing and
children.content: evaluation to ensure that materials and processes are characterized in a statistically significant manner relative to the design application.

children.title: Material Properties Testing Plans and Procedures
Describe the plans to use a
children.content: testing and evaluation strategy supports the building block approach (coupon, element, sub component). Describe the rationale for using approaches other than the building block approach.

children.title: Describe the plan for the implementation of
children.content: procedures used for monitoring and controlling processes critical to satisfying part design requirements.

children.title: Describe the plan for identifying
children.content: monitoring, controlling, and analyzing key process parameters.

children.title: Describe the process for determining and
children.content: evaluating process capability, including management and reduction of process variation.

children.title: Describe the methodology to be used
children.content: to determine and substantiate thermal exposure time histories.

children.title: Describe the plan to substantiate composite
children.content: sandwich construction properties, including those analytically derived from sandwich constituent properties to permit for the statistical determination of the material properties.

children.title: Describe the methodology that will be
children.content: used for process verification testing of test coupons (representative of the production part) and their associated acceptance criteria.

children.title: Material Properties Test Schedule
children.content: Describe a materials and processes testing schedule that includes the characterization, testing, and analysis planned with respect to critical path milestones against the contractor's integrated master schedule.

children.title: Material Properties Substantiation
Describe the methods that will be
children.content: used to substantiate material properties by using standardized documentation, analyses, tests, and inspections to characterize the following properties: static strength, fatigue strength, modulus, effect of stress concentrations, fracture toughness, crack growth, impact resistance, effects of defects, resistance to environmentally-assisted cracking, wear, general corrosion, pitting, stress corrosion cracking, exfoliation, galvanic corrosion, crevice corrosion, filiform corrosion, moisture absorption, chemical, solvent, fuel, and lubricant exposure; hydrolytic instability, thermal exposure, electromagnetic compatibility, adhesion strength, peel resistance, dielectric constant, resistivity, glass transition temperature, and erosion.

children.title: Describe the approach for substantiating the
children.content: effects of environmental exposure and operating environment on material properties.

children.title: Describe the methods that will be
children.content: used to substantiate materials specifications selected for protective finishes, protective coatings, and sealants for corrosion protection.

children.title: Material Allowables Development
Describe the design allowable philosophy that
children.content: will be used to develop the system materials, and document how the data will be generated and used to determine material properties.

children.title: Describe the analytical procedures that will
children.content: be used to calculate static and dynamic material allowables.

children.title: Describe the static material allowables methodology
children.content: in statistical terms of confidence levels and exceedance values.

children.title: Describe the methodology used to substantiate
children.content: the impact of inorganic finish systems on material allowables.

children.title: Describe the approach to generate composite
children.content: laminate data (including data analytically derived from single-ply properties) to permit for a statistical determination of the laminate properties.

children.title: Describe a plan to substantiate the
children.content: system materials' fracture toughness values used in the residual strength analysis of metallic parts will be the minimum substantiated fracture toughness values.
